mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing one excitatory input with two simultaneous inputs made threshold and summation clear, including that the outgoing spike is a new event rather than an incoming spike crossing the gap.

leastWorthwhile.text: The grey-matter construction was less informative than the voltage comparisons: its picture lists a dense mesh but does not explain how that arrangement functions.

surprise.text: The mixed-input trace dipped below resting voltage even though both incoming neurons fired, distinguishing inhibition from a merely subthreshold excitatory response.

arbitrary.text: Adding inhibition to two excitatory inputs failed, while adding it to one worked. The restriction was not apparent from the pictures or goal.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these networks connect to movement, provided the next chapter explains their functions as clearly as the threshold comparisons.
